bugs.description: _compare_table_comment tests conn_comment is None instead of is not None in the drop-comment branch, so that branch can never run and a table comment that was removed from the metadata is reported as a CreateTableCommentOp with a None comment instead of a DropTableCommentOp.
test_render_add_column_with_empty_comment only asserts that the rendered text is not empty, so it no longer checks that an empty string comment is emitted as comment='' in the add_column call.
